name: Tax Calculator
description: This simple tool helps users estimate their tax obligations based on their income and deductions. Ideal for individuals and small business owners wanting to plan their finances better.
metaDescription: Calculate your taxes easily and swiftly. Free tool, no signup required!

faqs.question: What information do I need?
faqs.answer: You'll need your income, any deductions, and filing status.

faqs.question: Is this calculator accurate?
faqs.answer: It provides an estimation based on current tax laws.

faqs.question: Can I save the results?
faqs.answer: Currently, this tool does not save results, but you can note them down.

variants.metaDescription: Estimate taxes specifically for self-employed individuals.
variants.headline: Calculate your tax obligations as a self-employed individual.
Understand your tax obligations based on your state.
